children: On-chain analyst Tom Wan said on X that the total value of Robinhood stock tokens has reached $50 million, and the number of holders with positions worth more than $1 has doubled since the start of the month. According to Odaily, Robinhood Chain stock token integrations with DeFi continue to expand, with connections to DEXs including Uniswap, Arcus, Deepstate, and Rialto, as well as Lighter perpetual contracts and the Morpho lending protocol.

title: Robinhood Stock Token Value Reaches $50 Million as DeFi Integrations Expand
